q: Would you like to be part of a successful team?
Join our innovative Coiled Tubing and Production Enhancement team

At Baker Hughes, our purpose is clear. We take energy forward making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet. Our team partners with the business to effectively enable and sustain change to improve our performance.

As a Service Delivery Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating daily Coiled tubing and production enhancement operations, ensuring efficient resource utilization, and delivering exceptional service quality. You will work closely with customers, field personnel, operations, maintenance, and logistics teams to ensure the safe and successful execution of projects.
r: Coordinating daily Coiled Tubing and Production Enhancement operations.
Acting as the primary liaison between customers, field crews, operations, maintenance, and logistics teams.
Scheduling personnel, equipment, and materials for upcoming jobs.
Monitoring job execution and ensuring compliance with client requirements, company procedures, and HSE standards.
Tracking service delivery KPIs, job performance, NPT, and operational efficiency.
Preparing job plans, service reports, post-job reviews, and client documentation.
Managing the mobilization and demobilization of equipment and personnel.
Supporting cost control, invoicing accuracy, and operational reporting.
Ensuring equipment readiness through coordination with maintenance and asset teams.
Participating in risk assessments, pre-job meetings, and incident investigations when required.
To be successful in this role you will
Have a minimum of 10 years of experience in Coiled Tubing and Production Enhancement (Frac).
Have at least 3 years of experience in business management.
Have strong P&L (Profit & Loss) management experience.
Have prior experience working with KOC; this is preferred but not required.
Have strong oral and written communication skills.
Have strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
Have the ability to influence others and lead small teams.
